summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with 5 years of commercial experience designing, building, and scaling end-to-end web experiences for major enterprise conglomerates (Indonesian Financial Group, PT Bukit Asam). Expert in bridging modern, highly interactive UI frameworks (React, Next.js, TypeScript) with robust backend services (Python, Node.js, GraphQL, REST APIs). Deeply experienced in utilizing GenAI and AI-assisted engineering tools (Cursor, Copilot, LLM Agents) to accelerate workflows and uphold rigorous code quality.
